params.body:
## What Shane saw (staging)

Own stock list, select vehicles, Hulpmiddelen, Showroomaffiche. For a vehicle without a NOx value the warning "Energy Card niet beschikbaar" opens. "Toch afdrukken" did nothing; the cross did nothing either.

## Two separate faults in one fragment

1. **"Toch afdrukken" called a function that no longer exists.** The fragment `AfficheController::check` returns ended in `onclick="doShowroomprint(false)"`. That function lived in the `<script>` of the old `ownstock/index.blade.php`; the Livewire list rebuilt the flow under another name in its `open-affiche` listener, but the server-rendered fragment kept the old name. The click threw `ReferenceError: doShowroomprint is not defined` and the screen stayed silent.
2. **The cross and "sluiten" never found the open modal.** The dismiss handler in `modal.js` walks up from the button to the closest `.modal` and asks whether that one is on the stack. The fragment's `.modal-dialog` carried the class `modal` itself, so the walk stopped one level early on an element that was never opened. (`settings/release_notes/detail` has the same pattern.)

`HandlerWiringTest` only knew the object globals (`vehicle.x()`), so a bare function name in an `onclick` was never checked.

## What changed

- `vehicle.showroomPrint(ids, {check, print}, check)` in `resources/js/vehicle/vehicle.js`: the poster flow on the global the blades already reach. With `check` it runs the NOx check first and then shows the warning or opens the poster; with `check=false` it closes the warning and opens the poster for exactly the selected ids. The Livewire list (`livewire_preview.blade.php`), the warning and the dead header item all call the same function.
- The warning renders the ids as integers (`[12,34]`): `request()->get('ids')` gives strings, and a quote inside `onclick="..."` ends the attribute.
- `modal._entryFor` walks every `.modal` ancestor until it finds the open one, and the fragment carries `modal` on the shell only. Both, so the cross also works in other fragments with the same class mistake.
- `HandlerWiringTest` gained a third check: every bare function an inline handler calls must be defined somewhere (a `function name(` in a blade or module, or `window.name =`). With `doShowroomprint` put back it fails on exactly that line.
- `ShowroomPosterWarningTest` pins the fragment as the browser gets it (one vehicle: edit link to tab 6; a selection: the multi text and a close button; one `.modal` shell; integer ids) and that the print route makes the poster for a vehicle without NOx.
- Rule S2-9.6 in `docs/bedrijfsregels/12-s2-eigen-wagenpark-publiceren.md`, finding `2026-09-15-affiche-waarschuwing-knoppen.md` (opgelost, ernst nu).

Not touched: `own-stock-list.blade.php`, `_wagen_rij.blade.php`, `OwnStockList.php`, the poster PDF itself.

## Verified locally

Seeded a dealer with two vehicles without NOx and one with. Before (old bundle, old blade): three `doShowroomprint is not defined` errors, no request, modal still open after print, after the cross and after "sluiten". After: no console errors; "Toch afdrukken" closes the warning and opens a new tab with `GET /showroomaffiche?ids=[21864,21865]` -> `200 application/pdf` (and `ids=[21864]` for one vehicle); cross and "sluiten" close the modal and remove the backdrop. Screenshots at 1440 and 390.

Tests: `Affiche|Showroom|HandlerWiring|AlpineExpression|CompiledViews|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity|RulesDocsBuild|StylesheetSyntax`: OK (46 tests, 866 assertions).
params.title: The poster warning's buttons work again
